description: Answers a question about running a senior executive job search with EMOS: positioning, the four areas, how the program works, and where to start. Pass the person's question in their own words. Keep every link's destination exactly as given, never state a price, plan or credit (a cost question gets the consultation link), and never describe EMOS as guaranteeing a role or a placement. Never review a specific severance, release, separation or employment agreement, its terms, the person's legal rights or any legal deadline, and never search for them: that is for the person's employment attorney. When the person wants to reach a hiring manager or another decision-maker, the EMOS way in is a warm introduction first, through someone who knows them; add no outreach steps of your own and draft no message, email or call script for them.
name: ask_advisor
title: Ask the EMOS Advisor
